title: Audi defends plans for a $4 billion Georgia plant amid VW restructuring, tariffs
summary: Audi's CEO has publicly defended the company's ambitious $4 billion investment in a new manufacturing plant in Georgia. This strategic decision is aimed at enhancing sales performance while simultaneously mitigating the risks associated with U.S. tariffs. The move reflects Audi's commitment to expanding its footprint in the American automotive market amidst ongoing restructuring within its parent company, Volkswagen.
